cards.h1: FROM SCRAPPY FRIGATE TO TITAN CARRIER
cards.sub: Beat zone bosses for blueprints, bank the shards, and watch one hull evolve through ten classes.

rows.t: A clean upgrade ladder from nimble Frigate to galaxy-dominating Titan Carrier.
Bosses drop the schematics — complete a set and the evolution fires instantly.
More mounts, more drones, more raw power at every tier you reach.

cards.caption: From scrappy Frigate to Titan Carrier — 10 hull classes, 47 hulls, one evolving fleet. Beat bosses, bank blueprints, evolve → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #progression

cards.sub: Every kill can cough up an upgrade. Gear rolls across twelve glowing rarities and six slots.

rows.t: Common climbs all the way to Primordial — each tier brighter, rarer, meaner.
Cannon, munitions, hull, thrusters, targeting, shield core — hot-swappable mid-run.
Drops arc out, then snap to your ship. Nothing on the field is left behind.

cards.caption: Every kill can drop an upgrade. 12 rarities, 6 slots, a loot magnet that vacuums the whole haul → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #lootgame

cards.h1: ONE FLAGSHIP. FOUR ESCORTS. EVERYBODY FIGHTS.
cards.sub: Your bench is not decoration — every hull in the fleet feeds the fight.

rows.t: Escort hull mods and stowed gear pay into your flagship's live stats.
Benched carriers launch their own fighters from their own decks.
The support hull fires nothing — it pulses repairs across the fleet instead.

cards.caption: One flagship, four escorts, and every single one of them fights. Fleet share, live carrier wings, repair pulses → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #fleetbuilding

cards.tag: Fly the escort by hand — collapse rings, void anomalies, a sector boss.

cards.h1: CLAIM TILES. RAISE CITADELS. KEEP WHAT YOU WIN.
cards.sub: My Galaxy is a shared map of real players — every tile pays hourly income.

rows.t: Every tile is held by a real pilot or their citadel. Break it, take it.
Win a fortified tile and the fortress is YOURS — at the rank they built it.
Fresh captures are attack-shielded — build up before the counter-siege.

cards.caption: A shared galaxy of real players. Siege their tiles, seize their citadels INTACT, collect the income → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #spacegame #territorywar

cards.h1: YOUR FLEET GRINDS WHILE YOU SLEEP
cards.sub: Close the tab. The war economy keeps running — a full report is waiting when you dock back in.

rows.t: Kills, loot, gold and XP accrue as if you'd kept flying — deaths included.
Colony production ticks around the clock. Just keep the pirates off it.
Every tile you hold deposits income whether you're online or not.

cards.caption: Log off. Your fleet doesn't. Offline battle sim, moon mines, hourly territory income — the grind runs 24/7 → lootfleet.com #lootfleet #idlegame #spacegame
